cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only helping with the packing. Before you zip that suitcase, let me wrap the jam so it doesn't leak.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already wrapped in my jumper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the jumper you'll need on the train. I'll unpack it and choose something else; don't trouble yourself with the tissue paper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I haven't given you a fair chance to choose. I'll open it and fetch two spoons. You can decide after we've tasted it together.
